title: Assistant Operations Manager - Remote| Singapore Company
description:
ASSISTANT OPERATIONS MANAGER — REMOTE (Female Only)| SINGAPORE COMPANY

Slim Sassy Strong Pte Ltd | Remote Full-Time | php20K–45K+ | Singapore travel opportunities



You’re good at your job. You’re just tired of the commute.

You’ve spent years working onsite — handling clients, managing workflows, keeping things running. You’re competent, you’re professional, and you show up.

But the traffic is costing you 2–3 hours every day. Hours you’d rather spend building something.

We’re offering you a way out of the commute — without stepping back in your career.



Slim Sassy Strong is a women’s wellness education company headquartered in Singapore. We are hiring one Assistant Operations Manager to join our remote operations team, with a structured path to Operations Manager and Senior Operations Manager.



This is a serious career role, not a work-from-home side gig.



|Phase   |Role                     |Compensation    |

|--------|-------------------------|----------------|

|Month 1 |Training                 |php20,000 fixed   |

|Phase 2 |AOM (KPI-based)          |php28,000 starting|

|Phase 3 |Operations Manager       |php35,000–php45,000 |

|Advanced|Senior Operations Manager|php45,000+        |



Plus: selected tea
mbers travel to Singapore for company events and operations.

Advancement is based on performance — not time served.



You will work directly with Singapore-based leadership as an operational extension of the business:

	-	Manage executive calendars and protect leadership time

	-	Own structured
 communication and client follow-ups

	-	Track KPIs, deadlines, and team task execution

	-	Conduct client-facing calls — professionally and confidently

	-	Support the consult pipeline and marketing-to-ops handover

	-	Maintain SOP compliance and operational documentation



As you grow into OM, you lead the team, own systems, and make decisions independently.

Client communication is a core part of this role — not an occasional task.



Why this works for you:

	-	No commute. Work from home, full-time, with a Singapore company on your resume.

	-	Real career track — AOM / OM / SOM with compensation that grows with your scope

	-	Singapore travel — top performers join us onsite for events and operational stints

	-	Above-market ceiling — 45K+ for senior performers

	-	Long-term stability — we grow with people who perform; we don’t churn talent



You’ll do well here if:

You’ve worked onsite in operations, client coordination, admin, hospitality, or a similar field. You’re used to being relied on. You’re not looking for an easy job — you’re looking for a better setup to do your best work in.

Specifically, you:

	-	Are confident handling clients directly — calls, not just chat

	-	Stay composed and professional under pressure

	-	Meet deadlines without being chased

	-	Communicate clearly and directly, especially when escalating

	-	Are fast with digital tools and willing to learn new systems

	-	Want to build a career, not just collect a paycheck

	-	You don’t mind putting in extra hours when it counts. You just want those hours to actually mean something.



Technical requirements

	-	Minimum 50 WPM typing speed

	-	Strong written and spoken English — business standard

	-	Stable internet with a documented backup connection

	-	Own laptop suitable for business use

	-	Familiarity with Google Workspace or similar tools



How to apply:



 with the exact subject line:

Assistant Operations Manager Application

Include all of the following — incomplete applications will not be reviewed:

	1.	One paragraph: what you’ve handled onsite and why you’re ready to bring that to a remote leadership role

	2.	Your current city and power/internet stability details

	3.	Device specs + internet speed screenshot

	4.	Your backup plan during outages

	5.	A 1–2 minute informal audio introduction

	6.	DISC profile screenshot (OnlineJobs)

	7.	Typing test screenshot (min. 50 WPM)

title: ASSISTANT OPERATIONS MANAGER – CLIENT EXPERIENCE (Female only, Full-Time, Remote – Philippines)
description:
Join a mission-driven company empowering women across Asia to live stronger, healthier, and more confident lives.



We're expanding our operations team — and we're looking for a sharp, polished, and proactive Assistant Operations Manager to be the professional frontline between our clients and our Singapore leadership team.



This is a long-term, full-time position with real career growth for the right person.



YOUR ROLE

You'll work directly with our Operations Manager and Singapore-based Director, supporting the full client journey — from onboarding through to programme completion — while ensuring backend operations run accurately and on time.



Your main responsibilities:

> Manage client onboarding, scheduling, confirmations, and reminders per SOP

> Handle professional client communications via phone, Zoom, and messaging platforms

> Coordinate with Singapore-based coaches and leadership on session logistics and events

> Maintain accurate records across CRM systems, trackers, and shared drives

> Support webinar logistics — registration follow-ups, nurture calls, and attendance confirmation

> Monitor group chats, respond to client queries, and escalate where needed

> Conduct call audits and document client interaction logs

> Uphold confidentiality and professional standards at all times



WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING WITH US

- 95% Remote — work from home without the commute

- KPI-based pay — your effort is directly rewarded

- Stable, long-term career role — not a project, not a gig

- Singapore travel opportunity — top performers join us onsite for company events

- Clear SOPs and structured onboarding — you'll never be left guessing

- Leadership that's direct, fair, and invested in your growth

- Training and continuous development — we build you up as we grow

- Integrity-first culture — no politics, no drama



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE:

> Excellent English — written and spoken, polished and professional

> Typing speed of at least 45 WPM

> A warm, confident phone and Zoom presence — clients will speak with you directly

> Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

> Experience in client-facing roles: corporate admin, BPO, hospitality, customer success, or similar

> Proficiency with Google Workspace, CRM tools, and Zoom

> Reliable internet with a backup plan

> A quiet, professional home workspace with webcam and good lighting

> A track record of follow-through, accuracy, and proactive communication



NOT A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

> Have other part-time or freelance commitments

> Are uncomfortable speaking directly with clients on calls

> Struggle with deadlines, SOPs, or working independently

> Need to be reminded to complete recurring tasks

> Respond to challenges with excuses instead of solutions

> Have frequent internet or power disruptions without a contingency plan



We need someone who takes ownership, communicates without being prompted, and holds themselves to a high standard.



WORK HOURS

Tuesday to Saturday | 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM (Singapore Time) Aligned with our Singapore operations and client base.



OUR COMPANY VALUES

Everything we do is built on five non-negotiables:

Honesty — tell the truth, always

Integrity — deliver with excellence and accuracy

Commitment — follow through, every time

Growth Mindset — keep learning, keep improving

Team Spirit — respect, collaboration, and positivity

 with the subject line: "AOM – Client Experience" and include clear, complete answers to ALL of the following:

We're a new company to fashion industry in the USA which brings herritage European designs with a modern touch of convenience. 



We're hiring one person to drive growth across both sides of the business: closing wholesale relationships and managing our retail presence, while also owning the social and content voice that brings our DTC brand to life.



Please start your cover letter with "I speak perfect English". That needs to be true and also shows us that you read the post. All other appicants will be ignored. 



This is a hybrid sales-and-marketing seat, split roughly evenly between two functions:



B2B Sales & Outreach (~50%)



Directly contact boutiques, independent retailers, and resellers to pitch wholesale partnerships (we have a list). 

Manage the full outreach cycle: prospecting, cold
/DM outreach, follow-up, negotiation, onboarding.

Maintain a pipeline of leads and partner accounts (CRM or structured tracker).

Represent the brand professionally in every external communication — tone and polish matter.

Support marketplace account management as we expand to wholesale platforms.



B2C Marketing & Content (~50%)

Plan and execute social media (Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest) — content calendar, captions, community engagement, trend awareness

Write and optimize product listings and on-site copy for our Shopify store, with SEO best practices for luxury/fashion search intent

Stay current on retail and fashion e-commerce trends and suggest campaigns, collabs, or content formats that fit our brand voice

Collaborate with the founder on launches, seasonal campaigns, and brand storytelling





What We're Looking For



Fluent, polished English — written and spoken. This is non-negotiable: you'll be writing customer-facing copy and pitching real business partners. Native English not required if your fluency is excellent.

Proven e-commerce and/or sales experience — outreach, account management, or DTC marketing background. Direct fashion/luxury experience is a strong plus, not a requirement.

Social media fluency — you understand platform-specific content (not just posting the same thing everywhere) and can speak to current trends without being told what they are.

Shopify familiarity — comfortable editing listings, understanding storefront basics; admin experience preferred.

SEO literacy — understands on-page SEO for product and content pages, especially how it applies to fashion/luxury search behavior (keyword intent, descriptive copy that still converts).

Self-directed — this is a founder-led startup; you'll need to work independently, propose ideas, and manage your own pipeline without heavy oversight.

Comfortable with both cold outreach and creative work — the split matters. We need someone who won't burn out doing sales
s one day and content calendars the next.



Compensation will be a combination of competitive hourly rate (up to $5/hour) plus bonus based on results.

Experience with wholesale platforms (e.g., Faire) or retail marketplaces

A portfolio or examples of past social content / product copy you've written

Familiarity with CRM or outreach tools (any — we're not locked into a specific stack yet)

title: Intake Client Success & Outreach Coordinator
description:
Intake Client Success & Outreach Coordinator 

Join a Growing Estate Planning Law Firm Making a Difference in Families’ Lives

Lungu Law Group is a boutique estate planning law firm based in California. We help individuals and families protect what matters most through personalized estate planning, trust administration, and ongoing legal guidance.

We are looking for an energetic, organized, and people-oriented Virtual Client Success & Outreach Coordinator to become the first point of contact for prospective clients while helping us expand our presence in the communities we serve.

This is much more than an administrative position. You will play a vital role in helping families take the first step toward protecting their loved ones while supporting the firm’s continued growth. You will build relationships with prospective clients, coordinate outreach efforts, schedule consultations, and ensure every person who contacts our firm receives an exceptional experience.

If you enjoy connecting with people, building relationships, solving problems, and making a meaningful difference, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

Your mission is to create an exceptional first impression of Lungu Law Group by delivering outstanding client service, nurturing prospective clients, building community relationships, and helping qualified families schedule appointments with our attorney. Every interaction should reflect our firm’s commitment to compassion, professionalism, education, and excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Client Success & Intake

• Serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients by phone,
, text, and online inquiries.

• Listen carefully to understand each prospective client’s needs and determine how our firm can help.

• Schedule consultations and Life & Legacy Planning Sessions.

• Follow up consistently with prospective clients to answer questions and encourage them to schedule an appointment.

• Maintain accurate client records and follow-up tasks within the firm’s CRM.

• Deliver an exceptional client experience from the initial inquiry through the scheduled appointment.

Outreach & Relationship Building

• Conduct proactive outreach to local businesses, professionals, and community organizations to introduce our firm and its educational programs.

• Build relationships with referral partners, including financial advisors, CPAs, real estate professionals, insurance professionals, and community organizations.

• Coordinate educational workshops, webinars, and community presentations.

• Follow up with attendees after seminars, presentations, and networking events.

• Help identify new opportunities to build relationships within the communities we serve.

Marketing & Client Engagement

• Assist with newsletters,
 campaigns, and client communications.

• Support social media engagement and online community outreach.

• Help promote workshops, educational events, and firm initiatives.

• Track referral sources and marketing activities to measure effectiveness.

Administrative Support

• Send welcome
s, intake forms, and appointment confirmations.

• Ensure prospective clients complete all required forms before their appointment.

• Organize electronic client files and maintain accurate records.

• Assist with administrative projects and workflow improvements.

• Support the attorney and team with special projects as needed.

Who You Are

You are someone who:

• Genuinely enjoys helping people.

• Is warm, confident, and professional in every interaction.

• Has outstanding spoken and written English communication skills.

• Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

• Is comfortable making outbound calls and following up with prospective clients.

• Enjoys building relationships and connecting with new people.

• Is proactive, resourceful, and takes initiative.

• Learns new technology quickly and enjoys improving systems.

• Thrives working independently while remaining accountable to a team.

• Takes pride in delivering exceptional customer service.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following is preferred:

• Customer Success

• Client Relations

• Appointment Setting

• Inside Sales

• Customer Service

• Business Development

• Legal, Financial, Insurance, Healthcare, or other Professional Services

• CRM software

• Google Workspace

• Microsoft Office

•
 marketing or social media coordination

Estate planning experience is not required. We provide comprehensive training on our systems, processes, and client experience standards.

Why Join Lungu Law Group?

At Lungu Law Group, we believe estate planning is about more than legal documents—it is about helping families protect the people they love and creating peace of mind for future generations.

Our culture is built on compassion, integrity, professionalism, accountability, continuous improvement, and genuine care for our clients. Every member of our team plays an important role in making a lasting difference in the lives of the families we serve.

If you’re looking for more than just a job—and want to be part of a growing firm where your contributions truly matter—we’d love to hear from you.

How to Apply

Please submit the following:

• Your resume

• A brief cover letter explaining why you are interested in this position

• A 2–3 minute video introducing yourself and sharing why you believe you would be a great fit for this role

• A brief description of any experience you have with customer service, appointment setting, client success, sales, or relationship management

We look forward to meeting someone who shares our passion for helping families and delivering an exceptional client experience.

title: Online Events Manager
description:
Online Events Manager & Administrative Genius - Vet Education



STOP.



Before you go any further, read this. Applications are accepted by direct
 only, to 
 to detail is the whole job, so please send us exactly what we have requested under HOW TO APPLY below.



Are you an English language enthusiast with a flair for creative writing and a keen eye for grammar and spelling? Do you have a passion for technology and a track record of successfully managing busy events – be it online or physical?

If you are, VetEducation is looking for you to join our team as an Online Events Coordinator

About VetEducation



We’re more than your average veterinary CE provider - and we’re proud of that. Since 2007, VetEducation (
) has delivered premium online courses and webinars to veterinary professionals worldwide. We're here to help our community thrive with clinically relevant, engaging education - and we want to grow that mission with you on board.

Before we even start - the very first criteria is that you need to be CRAZY about animals.

We are part of the veterinary industry - so as colleagues, a deep love and respect for animals is the first thing we need to have in common.





Responsibilities and Skills Required: 



Impeccable English Communication - Non-Negotiable



This is the single most important requirement in this role. You will be communicating daily via video and
, with international veterinary clinicians, academics, and stakeholders across multiple time zones and cultures.

We need someone who thinks natively in English. You need to speak and write with natural fluency, confidence, and warmth. Your grammar, tone, and word choice should feel effortless rather than translated or AI generated.

If English is the language your brain reaches for first, we want to hear from you.

Your written and spoken English will be assessed at every stage of this application process.

Organisational Skills Under Pressure - Non-Negotiable



Online events have many moving parts- speakers, slide decks, registration links, tech checks, attendee communications, post production editing, key stakeholder communication and everything in between - done on time without exception.

We need someone with a proven track record of managing multiple concurrent projects without dropping the ball. Experience in event coordination, project management, IT project administration, or advertising production will be highly regarded.

In your cover letter to us, we want to see evidence of real systems, like checklists that you may have built you've built, workflows / systems you've created , and projects you've delivered on time when the pressure was on.

In your cover letter, please give us a specific example of a time you successfully managed multiple deadlines simultaneously. Tell us what your system looked like.

Attention to Detail - Non-Negotiable



Your role is a front facing role. hence, this is the skill that holds everything together in this role and it is also the hardest one to fake

What we mean here are things like - A wrong link in an attendee
. A speaker's name spelled inconsistently. A time zone error in a calendar invite. These are just some examples and in this role, these affect the entire flow of an event.

We need someone who catches errors before they go out. Someone who reads everything twice and who notices what shouldn't be there.

Tech Savviness: 



You will need to be well-versed in various technologies, including virtual event platforms, collaboration tools, and CMS platforms. You will be involved in video editing of the lectures that are produced and preparation of all the presentation material that is sent to you before an event. This role will require you to adapt quickly to learn and utilize new technologies effectively.

Event Coordination: 



You will be taking charge of planning, coordinating, and executing online events. To do this role efficiently and effectively, you will be managing all the moving parts that go into organising events.

You will need to be good at following existing checklists and creating your own as you see fit to create efficient workflows. Your responsibility is to ensure a seamless event and experience for all stakeholders.





Digital Partnerships:



You will collaborate with clients and digital partners to develop and nurture sponsorships and collaborations, and contribute to VetEducation's presence in the veterinary education space.

Marketing Support:



You'll work closely with our marketing team on social media engagement, content creation, and event promotion..

Initiative and Strategy:



We want someone who is proactive and displays initiative to identify opportunities for improvement, contribute to event strategies, and suggest innovative ideas to enhance the VetEducation’s digital presence.

Collaborative Team Player:



We're a small, close-knit team. Everyone chips in, everyone communicates, and everyone matters. As the company grows, this role will expand and you'll have opportunities to diversify your skill set if you choose to.





Some Additional Details:



This is a work from home position and your workday starts at 8:00 am IST. The role is full-time, 5 days a week, 40 hours a week- Mon - Fri.

Competitive compensation based on experience

A strong internet connection and your own computer is vital to this position as we communicate daily with tea
mbers and clients via video chat.

This is a busy role with a lot of international video communication between tea
mbers and clients-so we would need minimal distractions and a quiet office spaced during the time that you allocate to your role.

Reliability matters deeply to us. Unless you can wholeheartedly commit, please do not apply.



HOW TO APPLY FOR THIS ROLE: 



To apply, please send the following to Dr Charisma Judge - 

1) Your Resume and 



2) Your Cover letter - including a specific example of how you've managed multiple deadlines simultaneously, and what your system looked like. Experience in online events management or project management should be detailed here.

3) Writing samples that show us your everyday written voice. Real, dated

s only, no blogs or articles. Feel free to redact anything sensitive, names,

 communication with international clinicians and academics is a mainstay of this role, so this matters to us.

title: Expert AI Video Editor & Social Content Creator
description:
# Part-Time AI Video Editor & Social Content Creator



## About the Role



We are looking for a highly skilled, visually creative AI Video Editor and Social Content Creator based in the Philippines.



This is not an entry-level video-editing position. We need someone who is already experienced with AI-generated video, AI image editing, product replacement, background replacement and short-form social advertising.



You will work with existing product photography, raw video footage, creator content and creative direction to produce polished content for Meta, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and other digital platforms.



This is a remote, part-time position with the potential to grow into a larger long-term role.



## Responsibilities



* Edit short-form advertisements and organic social-media videos

* Create multiple hooks, openings and variations from existing footage

* Use AI to replace or modify backgrounds, locations, environments and objects

* Replace products in videos and photographs while maintaining realistic lighting, perspective, scale and shadows

* Place our products naturally into existing photographs and video scenes

* Turn still images into realistic video sequences

* Generate supplemental footage when the required shot does not exist

* Remove unwanted objects, people, logos and visual distractions

* Retouch and enhance product, lifestyle and creator photography

* Resize and reformat content for different social-media platforms

* Add captions, voiceovers, music, sound effects, transitions and motion graphics

* Create realistic AI-generated lifestyle, product and advertising imagery

* Maintain accurate product packaging, labels, proportions, colors and branding

* Organize project files and deliver finished assets according to deadlines

* Stay current with rapidly changing AI video and image-generation platforms

* Collaborate with our marketing team to improve creative performance



## Required Software Experience



Applicants must have strong professional experience with:



* Runway

* CapCut Pro

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Adobe Photoshop

* Adobe After Effects or an equivalent motion-graphics platform



Experience with several of the following is strongly preferred:



* Kling AI

* Google Veo

* Seedance

* Sora

* Midjourney

* Adobe Firefly

* Flux

* ComfyUI

* Nano Banana

* Topaz Video AI

* Topaz Photo AI

* ElevenLabs

* HeyGen

* Descript



You do not need to use every platform listed above. However, you must be able to select the right software for each project rather than relying on one AI tool for everything.



## Required Qualifications



* A strong portfolio of AI-generated and traditionally edited content

* Proven experience editing short-form social-media advertisements

* Advanced understanding of pacing, hooks, retention and platform-native editing

* Strong photo-editing and image-compositing abilities

* Ability to make AI-generated content look realistic rather than obviously artificial

* Excellent attention to product labels, packaging and brand consistency

* Strong sense of composition, lighting, typography, color and visual storytelling

* Ability to follow detailed creative direction

* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

* Strong written and spoken English

* Reliable computer, high-speed internet and file-management system



Experience with beauty, personal care, wellness, fashion, outdoor or consumer-product brands is highly desirable.



## What We Are Not Looking For



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to trim footage, add subtitles or apply CapCut templates.



We need a creative problem-solver who understands both traditional post-production and modern generative-AI workflows.



## Schedule



* Part-time remote position

* Approximately 15–20 hours per week initially

* Some overlap with U.S. business hours may occasionally be required

* Hours may increase based on performance and creative volume



## Compensation



$15–$20 USD per hour, depending on portfolio quality, experience, speed and technical ability.



Exceptional candidates with advanced AI compositing, motion graphics or performance-ad experience may be considered at a higher rate.



## Application Requirements



Please include:



1. A short introduction describing your AI video and image-editing experience

2. A link to your portfolio

3. Three examples of your strongest short-form social videos

4. Examples showing AI background replacement, product replacement or realistic image-to-video work

5. A list of the AI and editing platforms you use professionally

6. Your requested hourly rate

7. Your weekly availability

8. Your computer specifications and internet speed



Please begin your application with the words “ALPINE AI” so we know you read the complete job description.



## Paid Skills Test



Finalists will be invited to complete a paid creative test using supplied product assets and footage.



The test may include:



* Editing one short-form social advertisement

* Creating three different opening hooks

* Replacing or modifying a background

* Integrating a product naturally into an image or video

* Producing one AI-generated product or lifestyle image



The test will be evaluated based on realism, creativity, product accuracy, editing quality, speed and ability to follow creative direction.

title: Customer Experience Professional Superstar
description:
Job Overview:



We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Customer Experience Professional Superstars this role will emphasize in building and maintaining strong long term relationships with our customers. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication skills, a positive attitude and a passion for ensuring customer satisfaction while fostering loyalty and trust.



Key Responsibilities:

* Talk to customers everyday: Answer messages,
s, or calls from customers. Helping them with questions about orders, product and services

* Solve customer problems: Customer issues such as wrong items, delay, and complaint. Find out what happened and find a resolution quickly. Keep the customer updated until the issue is resolved.

* Follow-up with customers: Check in with customers after purchase to make sure they are happy. Ask for feedback and note any concerns

* Keep customers satisfied: Handle complaints calmly and professionally. Offer the best solution to make the customer happy

* Collect and share feedback: Record customers comments. Complaints and suggestions. Report common issues or trend to the team so improvements can be made

* Work with other teams: Coordinate with the logistics team, warehouse and sales team when needed

* Update Records: Log all customer interactions, issues, and actions taken in the CRM



About you:



* Can work independently with little supervision and learn new tools quickly

* Pays close attention to details and can identify the root cause of issues

* Stays calm and makes good decisions under pressure

* Manages time well and can handle multiple customers at once

* Flexible and open to changes in tasks, tools, or priorities

* Communicates clearly and confidently, including giving feedback to managers

* Experience with Australian furniture companies is a strong advantage

* Solid background in the e-commerce and retail industry



Qualifications:



* Proven experience in customer service, relationship management, or a similar role

* Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written)

* Strong interpersonal skills, empathy and intelligence, with an ability to build rapport with customers and internal teams

* Ability to handle difficult or sensitive situations with tact and professionalism

* Problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively

* Familiarity with CRM systems and other customer service software

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

* Ability to work independently and as part of a team





What we offer



* A competitive salary package will be offered, commensurate with experience and demonstrated capability.

* “13th month” performance based bonus paid in December

* Annual performance and salary review every June

* HMO with an additional dependent

* 10 days Vacation leave

* 5 days Sick leave

* 3 days additional PTO (Christmas day, New Year’s day, & Good Friday)

* Full-time day shift (9:00 am to 6:00 pm - Australian Eastern Daylight Time (AEDT))

title: Quick Hire for VA Call Handling
description:
Important: Selected applicants will receive a response within 24 hours. Due to the volume of applications, we may move forward with other candidates if we do not receive a timely response.



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance. 



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a voice-based role, we also offer non-voice positions with a heavier focus on administrative tasks, subject to availability and overall fit.



To apply: Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly.



(1) Where in the Philippines are you currently located? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



(2) Please submit a screenshot of your internet speed and a few samples of your previous work output.  



(3) Please submit two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund. 



(4) Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.



(5) Are you able to commit to a fixed 7-day, 6-hour work schedule during Central Standard Time (CST) hours? What is your expected hourly or monthly pay rate and earliest physical start date if hired.   



(6) Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. For each task, explain the exact step-by-step process you followed, the tools or systems used, and the typical result or output produced.



(7) If you were hired today, what are 3 specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



(8) What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



(9) Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: General Accountant - CPA REQUIRED
description:
Location: Philippines 

Reports to: Head of Accounting 

Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor, Remote 



At Firm Five, we modernize bookkeeping and fractional controllership. We serve a client base of 

emerging brands with $2M–$50M annual revenue in Canada and the US, helping them not only 

maintain their financial reporting but also optimize and automate their financial processes. Our 

clients rely on us for all things accounting and administration (we don't do tax work), and we take 

pride in delivering clarity, efficiency, and financial insight. 



POSITION SUMMARY: 

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Accountant that will handle the full 

accounting cycle for US and Canadian clients. Your primary responsibility is to complete all the 

accounting in QBO or Xero for clients in various industries on a monthly basis. 



COMPENSATION RANGE: 

PHP 90,000–110,000 per month, based on experience and skill level 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

-Chart of accounts setup 

-Bank reconciliations 

-Bank categorizations 

-Receipt management 

-Profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow statement preparation 

-Accounting for sales tax (No actual tax filings) 

-Accrual accounting and balance sheet adjustments 

-Excellent client communication via slack and
 (in English) 

-Adjusting entries and COGS 

-Opening balances and catchup bookkeeping 



QUALIFICATIONS: 

-Bachelor's degree in Accounting 

-CPA designation in the Philippines 

-3-5 years experience managing full cycle accounting for a book of clients, ideally in an accounting or bookkeeping firm 

-E-Commerce or inventory experience preferred but not required 



CHARACTERISTICS TO SUCCEED: 

-Passionate about numbers, accounting, and client management 

-Excellent communication skills with a passion for simplifying financial data 

-Proven project management skills with an ability to withhold deadlines successfully 

-Dependable collaborator with a strong team-oriented approach 

-Thrives in a high-pressure environment while navigating many competing priorities 

-Reliable internet and work from home equipment (laptop, keyboard, mouse) 

-Backup power supply 



WHY YOU WILL LOVE WORKING WITH US: 

-Competitive Salary & Benefits 

-Early employee incentive plan linked to growth of the company 

-Fully Remote with Flexible Hours (9AM to 1PM EST + 4 flexi hours) 

-Paid Holidays & Vacation 

-Paid Sick/Personal Days 

-Growth Opportunities 

-Bi-Weekly pay direct to your bank account via Wise 

-No screen tracking tools 



OUR COMMITMENT TO EQUITY & INCLUSION: 

At Firm Five, we are committed to fostering a culture of equity, inclusion, and respect. We value 

diversity in all its forms and believe that every individual deserves to be treated with dignity and 

given equal opportunities to thrive. We strive to create an environment where all people feel 

welcome, supported, and empowered. We are dedicated to continuous learning, reflection, and 

improvement in our practices and policies.

multi-location business experience

title: Content Writer
description:
Content Writer -- Australian Safety & Compliance (Part-Time, Remote)



We run a safety and compliance blog for an Australian manufacturing business. The content covers Australian standards, workplace safety regulations, and compliance topics relevant to emergency services and industrial sectors.

We are looking for a writer who can research properly and write in a clear, authoritative style. This is not general content work. You need to be comfortable reading technical documents, Australian Standards references, and government publications, then turning that into well-structured articles that a professional audience will actually read.



What you will be doing

Writing one to two articles per month. We provide the topic. You research, write, and reference it properly using academic or university-style referencing (APA or similar).



What we are looking for

Someone who has written technical or regulatory content before. You need to be able to read an Australian Standard or compliance document and understand it well enough to write about it accurately. Strong written English is essential. AI-generated content will not be accepted.



Rate: 550 PHP per hour



Hours: Varies, roughly 4 to 8 hours per article depending on complexity



Start: Immediately



To apply, send two writing samples. At least one should be technical, regulatory, or standards-based writing. No samples, no response.

title: Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant — Hospitality & Real Estate Operations
description:
About Us



We own and operate a growing portfolio of short-term, mid-term, and furnished rental properties across New England, along with a boutique hospitality brand. Our days are fast-moving and full of details — guest messages, invoices, leases, vendors, marketing, and a team of cleaners, contractors, and VAs who all need coordination.



We're looking for one person to become an extension of the owner: a true right hand who can take a task off our plate and get it done correctly, completely, and without hand-holding.



The Role — In One Sentence



You'll be our "mini-me": someone we can hand a to-do list to each morning and trust that by the end of the day, things are actually done — bills paid, guests answered, books reconciled, vendors called, follow-ups sent.



Core Responsibilities



Bookkeeping & Payments:

Pay invoices and recurring bills (utilities, vendors, phone systems, waste services, etc.)

Reconcile QuickBooks weekly and flag anything that looks off

Set up and manage auto-pay for utilities and services

Invoice clients and partners; track what's owed to us and follow up

Cancel unused software subscriptions and audit recurring charges





Guest & Tenant Communications

Respond to Furnished Finder inquiries and messages promptly and professionally

Handle Airbnb and direct-booking guest messaging using our protocols

Manage lease extensions: draft, send, track signatures, update records





Property & Listing Operations

Keep listing details current (photos, pricing, block-off dates, discount codes)

Match availability and pricing across platforms (PMS, 
, Airbnb)

Track supplies and place orders (linens, rugs, propane covers, etc.)

Maintain house manuals, SOPs, and property info sheets





Team & Vendor Coordination

Onboard new hires: system access, door codes, training schedules, HR notifications

Follow up with contractors and vendors until the job is confirmed done

Schedule meetings, send agendas, track action items from staff check-ins

Chase down open loops — interviews, referrals, approvals, payments





Inbox & Admin Management

Triage and manage multiple
 inboxes (personal and business)

Maintain dashboards, calendars, and task trackers

Make phone calls on our behalf (insurance, tax offices, utility companies, vendors)

Support marketing tasks: social posts, events calendar, influencer outreach coordination





Who You Are

Obsessively detail-oriented. You notice when a number doesn't match, a date is wrong, or a follow-up never happened.

A closer. You don't just start tasks — you finish them and confirm they're done.

A clear communicator. You write professional messages, ask smart questions when something's unclear, and give us short, useful status updates without being asked.

Trustworthy with sensitive information. You'll handle payments, financial records, and personal accounts.

Easy to work with. Low ego, low drama, high ownership. You take feedback well and adapt to how we like things done.

Proactive. If you see something that needs doing, you flag it or handle it.





Requirements

2+ years experience as a virtual/executive assistant, bookkeeper, or operations coordinator

Hands-on QuickBooks experience (reconciliation, not just data entry)

Excellent written English; comfortable making U.S. phone calls

Comfortable learning tools like property management systems (e.g., Newbook), Airbnb, Furnished Finder, Google Workspace, WhatsApp, Loom, and AI tools like Claude

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and availability during ET business hours

Bonus: experience in short-term rentals, hospitality, or property management





What We Offer

Competitive pay — we're happy to pay well for someone who truly gets it

Long-term, stable role with a growing company

Direct access to the owner and real responsibility from day one

Variety — no two days look the same





How to Apply



Send us:

Your resume

A short video) telling us about a time you took a messy list of tasks and got it all done

Your QuickBooks experience in 2–3 sentences

Your hourly rate and weekly availability



Applications that don't include all four items won't be considered — attention to detail starts here.

-
 marketing via Mailchimp

**What we need from you:**

- Fast learner with new software; comfortable troubleshooting before escalating

- Strong writing — professional
s and scroll-stopping captions

mbers

mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

title: Right-Hand Operator (Ground Floor) — Hot Inbound Leads Only, No Cold Calling — Build a Fence Company With Me
description:
Hi! I'm Kaleb, owner of a startup fence company in Michigan, USA. We're building a faster, smarter way for homeowners to get fence quotes — using satellite imagery and online mapping instead of the old drive-to-every-house sales process.



I'm not looking for someone to just do tasks. I'm looking for my right hand — one hungry, ambitious person who wants to get in at the ground floor and build this company with me. The person who proves themselves here doesn't stay a quoter. They become the core of my operations team, take on more, earn more, and grow as fast as the company does. If you've been waiting for a shot to prove what you can really do — this is it.



THE HONEST SETUP:

We're a startup, so I can't promise full-time hours yet, and I won't pretend otherwise. This role is performance-based — you earn at every stage as a lead moves toward a sold job (full breakdown below). The harder and smarter you work, the more you make and the faster this becomes a stable, full-time position with a monthly base. I want someone who sees that as the opportunity it is.



HERE'S WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT — AND EASY:

No cold calling. No outreach. No chasing strangers. Every lead you touch is a hot, incoming request — someone who already found us and asked for a fence quote. Most leads you won't even speak to; it's all done through the computer.



The one thing I ask: speed to lead. When a new lead comes in, you'll get an
 notification, and I need you to respond within 10 minutes. In this business, the company that answers first almost always wins the job. That's our edge, and it's your #1 responsibility. If you check your
 like a hawk and love being first to jump on an opportunity, you'll thrive here. If replying fast stresses you out, this isn't the role.



THE SETUP:

- 100% computer-based — no door-knocking, no in-person visits

- All leads are hot and inbound — no prospecting, ever

-
 notification the 
nt a lead comes in — respond within 10 minutes

- Most leads never need a phone call — it's handled online



IMPORTANT — HOURS:

Our leads come in on U.S. Eastern time (Michigan). To hit the 10-minute response, you'll need to be available during U.S. da
 hours. If you're willing to work U.S. hours, this role can grow into something big for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Study satellite and aerial images of U.S. homes — yards, driveways, garages, pools, sheds, patios, trees, and property layouts

- Identify where a fence would go based on what the customer wants

- Create accurate fence quotes using our process (I'll train you fully)

- Measure properties using online mapping tools

- Respond fast, follow up with leads, and keep customer info organized

- Take on more responsibility as fast as you can earn it



THIS IS THE CORE SKILL:

You'll spend real time looking at aerial views of American homes. You need to tell a front yard from a backyard from a side yard, spot driveways, gates, neighboring fences, pool areas, detached garages, and common obstacles — and understand where a new fence fits. No fencing experience needed, but comfort with maps and property layouts is a must. Accuracy matters — these quotes help real people make real buying decisions.



HOW YOU'LL BE PAID (PERFORMANCE-BASED):



Online leads — you earn at every stage:

- $3 for every completed, accurate quote

- +$20 when your quote leads to a booked final walk-through

- +$30 when that lead becomes a real, paying job

- A single online lead taken all the way through earns you $53



Phone support — highest-level English only:

Phone work isn't required. But if you have clear, professional, confident spoken English and want to earn more:

- $10 per qualified call handled

- $75 when a call turns into a real, paying job



Phone-capable people get first access to expanded commissions as we grow.



As we scale, the person who shows up hungry moves to a stable monthly base plus bonuses. I reward the people who build with me.



Paid in USD via Wise.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR:

- Hungry and ambitious — you want to grow, earn, and build, not just clock tasks

- Fast — you respond to opportunities immediately, not "when you get to it"

- Takes ownership and figures things out without being micromanaged

- Sharp, detail-oriented, and quick to learn

- Comfortable on a computer and familiar with Google Maps, Google Earth, or similar tools

- Available during U.S. hours and wants a long-term seat in a company they helped build



TO APPLY:

Start your message with the word "FENCE" (this tells me you actually read the whole post), then tell me a bit about yourself, your experience, and why you'd be a good fit. Also answer:



1. Have you used Google Maps, Google Earth, or satellite images for work before? Tell me how.

2. Looking at a satellite image of a home, how would you tell the backyard apart from the front yard? Describe what you'd look for.

3. Are you comfortable measuring property layouts from aerial images?

4. How would you rate your spoken English (1–10), and are you open to phone work for higher pay?

5. Tell me about a time you went above and beyond what was asked of you. What did you do, and why?

6. Are you available to work U.S. Eastern hours, and how fast do you typically respond to notifications?



I read every application that starts with FENCE. I'm looking for someone special — if that's you, show me. Looking forward to meeting you!

title: Founding Build Partner: Voice Al Platform (Unicorn, or Lead + Counterpart) | Rev Share + Exit Stake | Deciding in 48 Hou
description:
THE SHORT VERSION I am hiring ONE accountable technical lead to build TalkTuit, a voice AI receptionist that answers every call for plumbing and HVAC companies, books the job, and hands the owner their evenings back. You can be the rare engineer who covers the whole build alone, or a strong specialist who brings a trusted counterpart for your weaker side. Either way, I contract one accountable lead. Compensation is a monthly base plus revenue share plus a real exit stake, structure discussed after a small PAID audition. I am making my decision within 24 to 48 hours.

WHY THIS EXISTS I am a quadriplegic founder. I run this entire company by voice, every
, every document, every line of this ad. Before my injury I worked in the trades alongside family and friends, so I know exactly what happens when a plumber is elbow-deep in a job and the phone rings: the call gets missed, and a missed call is a lost job. TalkTuit exists so no tradesperson loses work because they were busy doing the work. You would not just be building software. You would be building the system that runs a company its founder physically cannot run by hand, which means automation here is not a buzzword, it is the whole point. If the machine we build together works, it changes what people believe a founder like me can build, and it gets acquired for real money that you share in.

WHAT YOU ARE BUILDING (the honest scope) Phase 0.5, about two weeks: one real paying client live on an off-the-shelf voice platform (Retell, Vapi, or Synthflow), one CRM integration, Stripe billing, owner text and
 summaries after every call, schema-enforced call records, and a fallback path so no call is ever dropped. Small on purpose. It earns the first dollars. Phase 1, realistic six to ten weeks: the productized platform on AWS: multi-client provisioning, an any-CRM adapter pattern, onboarding intake, production data layer, CI/CD, secrets, observability, and the security baseline. Later phases (retention systems, scale automation, back office, exit readiness) are revenue-funded roadmap, shown so you can architect for them, not bid them now. Two tracks, one lead. Track A: platform and security engineering (AWS, IaC, CI/CD, secrets, observability, cost, security baseline). Track B: product and automation engineering (the voice agent, telephony logic, CRM and calendar integrations, the auto-demo engine later, n8n workflows, Stripe, the data layer in code). A full PRD with measurable acceptance gates goes to serious candidates.

HOW SELECTION WORKS (proof over prose)

 You reply using the format below. Most of the vetting happens right there.

 Live proof: a voice agent at a real phone number I can call, not a video, not a link to someone else's work.

 A small PAID audition (fixed fee, about a week of scope): provision a number, stand up a demo agent from a website I give you, write schema-valid call records, text me a summary. You get paid either way. I judge shipped work, not claims.

 Winner signs IP assignment, confidentiality, and non-solicit before the first larger dollar, then Phase 0.5 begins immediately. I am non-technical and voice-first, so an independent senior engineer reviews finalist evidence. Please do not waste both our time with borrowed demos.

WHAT MAKES A YES Honesty about your limits beats confidence theater. The last two people who impressed me most told me what they could NOT do. Clear written English, daily communication, least-privilege security habits (you will never hold root, and that protects you as much as me), and pride in building systems that outlive your involvement.

COMPENSATION Monthly base plus revenue share plus exit stake, tied to shipped milestones with vesting. Real structure and numbers are discussed after the paid audition, not before, and never in public. If you need the security of a large salary today, this is honestly not your role. If you want ownership economics in a company you build the engine for, keep reading and reply.

 Your LinkedIn profile link.

 Your answers to everything below. Send all four by

 is the fast lane and the one I score first. Then:

 Your lane: UNICORN (both tracks), TRACK A LEAD (infrastructure and security, bringing a Track B counterpart), or TRACK B LEAD (product and AI, bringing a Track A counterpart). If you bring a counterpart, name who is the accountable lead and one thing you two shipped together.

 The skill scale below, rated 1 to 5. RULE: any 4 or 5 must include one line of proof: a link, a named system you built, or a specific problem you hit and fixed. A 4 or 5 with no proof line reads as a 2. a. AWS architecture and IaC (Terraform or CDK) b. CI/CD, secrets management, observability c. Security engineering and compliance awareness (least privilege, encryption, audit logging; SOC 2 or ISO 27001 preparation experience is a plus, name it with proof) d. CRM or calendar integration by API and webhook (name the CRM, the endpoint, and one failure you hit: rate limits, webhook retries, token refresh, dedup) g. Workflow automation (n8n, Make, or code) h. Stripe or payments integration i. Backend engineering (Python or Node) j. Telephony (Twilio or Telnyx: provisioning, forwarding, recording)

 A phone number with a live voice agent I can call this week, OR the words "will build it in the paid audition."

 Your realistic timeline and price, quoted SEPARATELY for: the paid audition, Phase 0.5, Phase 1. Do not blend them. Blended quotes are declined.

title: Virtual Assistant

We do not work through agencies. You will report directly to the broker and will be a core part of a small and focused team. If you take pride in your work, communicate clearly, and want a stable long term role in the mortgage industry, this is the right opportunity for you.



RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Reviewing and organizing client documents including bank statements, T4s, pay stubs, letters of employment, identification, and property documents.

2. Flagging incomplete, missing, or incorrect documents before they are uploaded to lender portals.

3. Updating and maintaining our active pipeline tracker in Google Sheets daily.

4. Following up with clients for outstanding documents via
 and phone.

5. Uploading documents to lender portals including Velocity.

s and client communication drafts for broker review.

7. Organizing and naming files in Google Drive according to our filing system.

8. Updating deal statuses and notes in our GoHighLevel CRM.

9. Completing assigned tasks independently and reporting back with results or flagging blockers immediately.

10. Attending a weekly team call every Monday and sending a daily written update Tuesday through Friday.



REQUIREMENTS (Non-Negotiable)



1. Minimum 2 years experience as a Virtual Assistant in mortgage, real estate, or financial services.

2. Strong working knowledge of mortgage document types and the general mortgage application process.

3. Excellent written and spoken English.

4. Extremely strong attention to detail. Errors in mortgage files have real consequences.

5. Professional quiet work environment with no background noise during calls.

6. Reliable high speed internet connection.

7. Available to work Canadian Eastern Time business hours Monday through Friday.

8. Proactive communicator. You do not go silent. You ask questions when stuck and report back when tasks are complete.

9. Experience with Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Gmail.

10. Experience with GoHighLevel or any mortgage CRM is a strong asset.

11. Experience with Velocity or any Canadian lender portal is a strong asset.



WHAT WE OFFER



1. Full time stable position with a growing Canadian mortgage brokerage.

2. Salary of $700 to $800 USD per month based on experience.

3. Performance review and salary increase after 3 months.

4. Direct working relationship with the broker, not a middleman agency.

5. Consistent Monday through Friday schedule with no weekend work.

6. Paid on time every time via Wise or Remitly.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this role, your application must include all of the following:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your mortgage or financial services experience.

2. One example of a time you caught an error or problem in a document or file before it caused an issue.

3. Your availability to start.

4. Confirmation that you have a quiet professional work environment.

5. Your expected salary within the $700 to $800 USD range.



Applications that do not answer all five points above will not be reviewed. We are looking for someone serious about this role and detail oriented enough to follow application instructions.

description:

What you'll do

s, draft replies for the founder's review, and make sure nothing gets dropped

* Before starting any task, confirm you understand it. If anything is unclear, ask first. Never guess and never go silent on a task you're stuck on.

* Everything you do gets documented. You'll send a short end-of-day summary every day: what you completed, what's in progress, what's pending, and what you're waiting on from others.





Must have

* Excellent written English. Most of your day is writing
s to American clients.

* At least 1 to 2 years of experience as a VA, secretary, or executive assistant, preferably for US clients

* Extremely detail-oriented and organized. You're the person who notices the missing attachment.

* Fast, proactive communicator. You reply quickly, ask questions early, and never leave people wondering where things stand.

* A friendly, positive, can-do attitude. Your default is "yes, I'll figure it out," not "that's not my job."

* Able to work Monday to Friday, US Eastern business hours, full-time

* Reliable high-speed internet, your own computer, backup power/internet plan, and a quiet workspace

* Comfortable in both the Google and Microsoft ecosystems (Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs/Sheets, plus Outlook, Word, Excel), and willing to learn our CRM and invoicing tools



Nice to have

* Experience with invoicing or billing follow-up

* Comfortable speaking on the phone in English



Trial period

This is a direct hire, not a test project. The first 30 days are a paid trial period. During that time, either side is free to d
 it's not the right match, no hard feelings. After that, you're a permanent part of the team.



What we offer

* Direct access to the founder and real responsibility from day one

* Training on all our tools and processes

 for a US client or employer.

You'll be handling a high volume of templated design work — social ads, website banners, PDFs — while also being the person who catches when something 'just looks wrong' and knows how to fix it.

We've worked with designers before who treated our briefs literally and produced mediocre work. We're not looking for someone to fill a template with text and call it done. We want someone who considers layout, typography, iconography, color hierarchy, and image selection as a unified system — and brings that discipline to every asset, no matter how routine.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Recurring Production Work

• Update monthly
 ad templates: swap in new unit images, pricing, and copy

• Produce banners for social media and website placements across both our Canadian and US-facing brands

Design System Stewardship

• Own and maintain our Figma file library: templates, brand assets, component sets

• Ensure consistency in typography, color, and image treatment across all assets

Design Thinking & Layout Improvement

• When given a brief, think past the literal request — consider how content should be grouped, what visual hierarchy makes it easiest to read, and whether icons or supporting graphics could help

• Apply this thinking to both new and legacy assets: our best work has come from rethinking the structure, not just prettifying what exists

Freelancer Coordination

• Source and manage Fiverr or similar freelancers for specialized work (custom illustrations, diagrams, etc.)

• Brief external creators, review their output against our standards, and manage revisions

REQUIRED SKILLS

• Proficiency in Figma, Adobe InDesign, and Adobe Illustrator — not just familiarity, but genuine fluency

• Strong sense of layout, grid systems, typographic hierarchy, and color

• Ability to select and crop images well — this matters more than people expect

• Experience with template-based production at volume

• Reliable, deadline-driven, and communicative — if something comes up, you say so

title: Chief Architect Drafter — Residential Construction
description:
ABOUT US



Southern Cities Construction is a licensed North Carolina General Contractor building a fast-growing investor execution platform for real estate flippers, wholesalers, and BRRRR operators across NC. We deliver GC-certified rehab budgets, scope-of-work packages, permit-ready construction documents, and full-service construction execution at volume — and we need a sharp draftsperson to power the design and documentation engine.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



You'll be the design and documentation backbone of our platform. Every deal that needs plans, elevations, or construction documents — from quick-turn investor renovation packages to full-build permit sets — passes through your desk.



- Produce floor plans, elevations, sections, and framing plans in Chief Architect for NC residential remodels, additions, and new builds

- Build accurate 3D models of existing properties (as-builts) and proposed designs

- Generate permit-ready construction document sets for submission to NC jurisdictions

- Create design visualizations and renderings for client-facing scope-of-work packages

- Modify and update existing plans based on field measurements, scope changes, and client direction

- Support our estimator with measured drawings and clean plan sets for accurate takeoffs

- Maintain a library of branded SCC plan templates, title blocks, and standard details

- Turn around quick-hit drafting requests within 48–72 hours for our productized offers

- Turn around full permit-ready document sets within 7–14 days for larger projects

- Coordinate with our estimator, project managers, and Darius to ensure plans match scope and budget



REQUIRED



- Chief Architect proficiency — daily user, comfortable with floor plans, elevations, framing, 3D modeling, materials lists, and construction document output (please send a sample plan set)

- 3+ years residential drafting experience (remodel / rehab / addition / new construction)

- Strong understanding of residential construction systems — framing, foundations, plumbing, electrical, HVAC routing

- Ability to read and interpret existing plans, field sketches, photos, and scope-of-work documents

- Familiarity with IRC (International Residential Code) basics

- Strong attention to dimensional accuracy and code compliance

- English fluency — written and spoken

- Detail orientation — drafting errors cost us permits and time

- Fast turnaround discipline — you can ship a clean plan set under deadline pressure



PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED)



- US residential drafting experience (especially Southeast US / NC)

- Working knowledge of NC building codes and NC permit submittal processes

- Experience with rehab and renovation drafting (not just new construction)

- Experience producing permit document sets for NC municipalities (Charlotte, Raleigh, Durham, Wilmington, Asheville, etc.)

- AutoCAD, SketchUp, or Revit as secondary tools

- Experience supporting real estate investors, flippers, or design-build GCs

- Photo-based as-built drafting (working from photos + measurements rather than a site visit)

- Familiarity with NC energy code and Manual J / Manual D basics

title: Inside SDR / Appointment Setter (Leads - Healthcare)
description:
MANDATORY VIDEO APPLICATION (Read Carefully)



We do not accept generic applications. To apply, you must record a short video (2-3 minutes) addressing the specific points below.



Video Instructions:



The Hook: You must verbally mention "BHT Group" in the first 10 seconds.



Past Experience: Tell us about the companies you have worked for previously.



The Niche: What specific services were you setting appointments for? (Highlight any healthcare/medical experience).



The Volume: What was your average daily call volume (inbound vs. outbound) and any other metrics that you're proud of in previous roles.



The Approach: Briefly explain how you handle a lead who claimed an offer online but claims they "don't have time to talk" when you call them.



BHT Group is looking for a relentless Appointment Setter to manage our lead flow for healthcare clients. These are warm leads—prospects who have requested an appointment or claimed a promotion online—but they require immediate action.



We need a hunter who is not afraid to pick up the phone. You will be responsible for calling these leads immediately, qualifying them, and booking them. Additionally, you will act as a "Gatekeeper" for our closers by calling to confirm online requests to ensure the lead is serious before our sales team spends time with them.



Compensation:



Base: Flat Monthly Rate.



Commission: Paid per SHOWN appointment.



Note: Your job is not just to put a name on a calendar, but to ensure they show up. The better you qualify and confirm, the more you get paid.



Key Responsibilities:



Speed-to-Lead Outbound Dialing: Immediately call leads who have submitted forms or claimed offers online. Speed is everything.



Inbound Response: Field incoming calls from marketing campaigns professionally.



Appointment Confirmation (Crucial): Review appointments requested online and call the prospect to verify their intent and qualify them before the appointment happens.



Follow-Up: Manage a pipeline of leads that didn’t answer on the first attempt (requires multiple touchpoints via Phone/SMS).



CRM Management: Keep detailed notes on every interaction.



Requirements:



Phone Warrior: You must be comfortable making 60+ outbound dials a day to warm leads.



Experience: Proven track record in appointment setting, preferably for high-ticket services or healthcare/med-spa offers.



Tech: Experience with dialers (GoHighLevel, etc.) and calendar management.



Thick Skin: Ability to handle objections and push past the initial "I'm busy" response.

You'll be calling US-based car repair shops and home service businesses on our behalf, working through provided lead lists to book appointments for our sales team. We're not looking for someone who just reads a script and hangs up. We want someone who listens, adapts, handles pushback, and actually enjoys the chase of getting someone to say yes to a meeting.

Hours align with California business time (8 AM to 5 PM PST, Monday to Friday), which means night shift on your end. Both part-time and full-time spots are open right now, up to 40 hours a week, so tell us what fits your life.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Making calls, qualifying prospects, booking appointments, and keeping everything logged cleanly in our CRM (we run GoHighLevel). You'll follow up on warm leads, chase down no-shows, and flag anything in the process that isn't working so we can fix it together.

Who We're Hoping to Find

Somebody with sharp, confident English, real cold calling experience, and a track record of actually booking appointments, not just dialing numbers. You know how to handle objections without getting flustered, you're comfortable with high call volume, and you've got a reliable setup at home (good internet, headset, quiet space). Whether you're looking for part-time or full-time, we want someone who's in it for the long haul.

If you've called into auto repair or home services before, or have experience with GoHighLevel, US campaigns, or agency/SDR work, that's a big plus, but not required.

What You'll Get

Flexible hours built around your availability, pay tied to your experience and hours committed, and it's paid out in USD through Wise, PayPal, or bank transfer. On top of that, performance bonuses for every appointment you book, rate reviews every 6 months, direct access to the business owners (no layers of management to wade through), and real room to grow as we scale, including a path to full-time if that's what you want. We provide all the tools, including GHL and a dialer.

No drama here. Just a high-performance team that moves fast and takes care of the people who show up for it.

Ready to Apply?

Send over:



Your resume

Quick answers to: why you're a fit, your cold calling/appointment setting background, and whether you're after part-time or full-time

Any proof of past work — call recordings, references, results from previous setter roles

Your expected rate (hourly or monthly, PHP)

A 2-3 minute Loom video covering who you are, your experience, why you want this role, and confirming your availability and ability to work PH night shift



One more thing: at the very top of your application, write the word SYSTEM. Applications missing this won't be reviewed.

Looking forward to meeting you,

Lighthouse Inc.

title: REO Portal Virtual Assistant Equator Pyramid RESNET Cascade
description:

Our team works directly with asset managers, lenders, and government entities and operates in fast paced, compliance driven environment. Accuracy, consistency, and follow through are critical in this role. This is a long term opportunity for the right virtual assistant who wants stability, growth, and real responsibility in the REO space.



We are seeking an organized, detail driven Virtual Assistant to handle foreclosure and REO tasking across multiple client portals. Accuracy is crucial in this role. This position supports properties from assignment through closing and requires strong follow through, deadline management, and the ability to work independently within structured systems. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in portals, following task checklists, and maintaining compliance without constant oversight.



Primary responsibilities include completing all required tasks in REO and foreclosure portals, maintaining daily updates and status changes, monitoring deadlines and escalation requirements, and accurately uploading documents, photos, bids, and reports. You will be responsible for maintaining compliance across all client instructions and identifying missing or incorrect items before they become issues. Strong comprehension is needed in this position.



This role also includes coordinating with field staff and vendors, ordering inspections, occupancy checks, preservation services, and repair bids, and following up as needed. Inspections and bids must be reviewed for completeness and obvious discrepancies before submission. You will assist with BPO tasking and organization, including managing photos, comparable data, and required documentation.



Additional responsibilities include coordinating utility turn ons and shut offs, requesting HOA payoff statements and resale disclosures, assisting with title related items such as deeds, tax information, and lien data, supporting MLS data entry and updates when needed, and maintaining accurate internal records and tracking.

Candidates must be able to troubleshoot issues as they arise and communicate clearly when escalation is needed.



Technical requirements include reliable high speed internet, a quiet home work environment, and proficiency with Google Workspace. Comfort using PDFs, spreadsheets, cloud storage, and task driven systems is required.



This is a full time position during Arizona, United States business hours. We offer a stable long term role with clear systems, structured training on our workflows and clients, and opportunities to grow into higher level REO coordination and oversight positions.



To apply, please include a brief summary of your REO or foreclosure experience, a list of portals you have worked in such as Equator, Pyramid, RESNET, Bid on Homes, or similar systems, and your availability to work United States business hours. Qualified candidates will be provided with a link to officially apply in our database.

Creating engaging visual sequences

Photoshop

Motion Graphics

Storytelling

Sound Design

mber of our editing team.
