title: Customer Service Manager — Shopify Stores (Long-Term, Full-Time)
description:
We're a fast-growing e-commerce group operating 30–50 Shopify stores. We work with a dedicated fulfillment partner (DayOne) and an external advertising agency running Google Shopping at scale. Our volume sits at 100+ disputes per week across Whop and PayPal. We communicate with our team via Slack and Sheets.



We're not a side hustle. This is a serious operation, and we're building it like one.



What we're hiring for:

We're looking for a Customer Service Manager — a true A-player who doesn't run customer service by hand, but steers the system behind it. Our AI runs the actual customer service: answering customer
s and handling disputes. Your job is to make that AI smarter over time. You continuously build, maintain, and improve the SOPs, workflows, flows, funnels, and templates we feed into the AI. Every opened dispute and chargeback is a signal to you: where does the AI's communication fall short, which flow creates friction, and which SOP needs to be sharper?



This is a thinking and building role, not only an execution role. You don't answer customer
s or handle disputes yourself — you make sure the system does that better and better, so customer satisfaction goes up and disputes and chargebacks structurally go down.



What you'll own:

Customer service SOPs & workflows for our AI (~50% of the role)

- Build, document, and maintain the SOPs and workflows our AI uses to run customer service

- Ensure the AI applies the right tone, empathy, arguments, and resolution per situation, per store, and per channel

- Translate insights from customer contact, disputes, and chargebacks into concrete improvements to the instructions, templates, and decision rules the AI uses

- Keep the template and SOP library structured, version-controlled, and up to date in Sheets

- Test changes and measure whether they actually increase customer satisfaction and reduce disputes



Customer journey, flows & funnels (~25%)

- Analyze where friction arises in the customer journey that leads to dissatisfaction, complaints, disputes, and chargebacks

- Translate those insights into improvements to customer communication flows and funnels

- Make sure customers receive the right communication at the right 
nt, so issues get resolved before they escalate



Pattern analysis as a learning source (~25%)

- Analyze 100+ disputes per week across Whop and PayPal, plus broader customer contact, to surface recurring root causes

- Identify patterns (recurring complaints, chargeback reasons, confusing communication, journey friction) and tie them back to concrete SOP, flow, and template changes

- Track per processor, per store, and per reason code which causes most often drive dissatisfaction and disputes

- Close the feedback loop: show that your changes structurally shrink the problem



Who you are:

This is a management and systems role — not a VA role, and not a frontline CS role. We're looking for someone who:

- Has led or optimized customer service operations for multi-store Shopify or DTC businesses (not just one store)

- Thinks in systems: you see a single complaint or dispute not as an i
 but as a symptom of an SOP or flow that can be better

- Has experience building and documenting CS SOPs, workflows, and customer communication templates

- Understands how good customer service structurally prevents dissatisfaction, disputes, and chargebacks

- Is comfortable steering AI tools and understands how to write instructions and templates an AI can execute well

- Senses what customers need and can translate that into the right tone and resolution in the AI's communication

- Communicates in clear, professional English — written and spoken

- Lives comfortably in Slack and Sheets and can set up and maintain structured processes

- Is proactive — you don't wait to be told what to do, you spot problems and propose fixes

- Is calm under volume — 100+ disputes a week doesn't faze you

- Owns outcomes, not tasks



Must-haves:

- 3+ years managing or optimizing customer service for an e-commerce business (Shopify preferred)

- Demonstrable experience writing and improving CS SOPs, workflows, and templates

- Insight into how complaints, disputes, and chargebacks arise and how to prevent them through better service

- Comfortable working across multiple stores and multiple payment processors (Whop and PayPal)

- Excellent written English

- Self-managed — full-time available, reliable internet, professional setup

- Available full-time (50 hrs/week), long-term commitment



Nice-to-haves:

- Experience with Whop disputes

- Experience steering or training AI tools for customer service

- Experience analyzing customer data to spot patterns

- Background in fashion / branded DTC

- Comfort working with AI tools (we're heavily AI-augmented and will give you serious AI leverage)



What we offer:

- Long-term, full-time role — we're hiring for years, not weeks

- Competitive rate based on experience (range: $5–10/hr, open to higher for the right person)

- Real ownership — you'll make the system behind our customer service measurably better

- AI leverage — our AI does the repetitive work so you can focus on judgment and design calls

- Growth path — as we scale to 50+ stores and a $100M brand portfolio, this role grows with us

- Direct access to the founder — no middle layers, no politics, no nonsense



How to apply:

We get a lot of templated applications. Here's how to make sure we read yours:

Start your cover letter with the word "EMPIRE" so we know you actually read this post.

Then, briefly tell us:

- How many Shopify stores have you managed or optimized simultaneously, and which payment processors did they use?

- Tell us about a time you turned a recurring customer or dispute problem into a concrete improvement in an SOP, flow, funnel, or template. What was the impact on customer satisfaction or disputes?

- How do you go about figuring out which part of the customer journey — or which SOP — is driving dissatisfaction or disputes?

- Do you have experience steering AI tools for customer service? If so, how?

- What's your timezone, and what hours can you commit to overlapping with CET (Netherlands)?

- Why this role specifically — what about it fits where you want to go in the next 2–3 years?



Applications without these answers will not be reviewed.

title: Experienced Real Estate Wholesaling Closer / Acquisitions Specialist
description:
We are looking for a proven real estate acquisitions closer who has already locked up wholesale real estate deals with motivated sellers.



This is not an entry-level cold calling role. Our team generates seller leads, and your job is to take qualified seller conversations, build trust, negotiate price, follow up properly, and get contracts signed.



You will be speaking directly with homeowners who may be interested in selling their property. You need to be confident on the phone, understand seller motivation, know how to ask the right questions, and be able to close deals without sounding pushy or scripted.



What You’ll Do:



Call and follow up with motivated seller leads

Speak directly with homeowners about selling their property

Build rapport and understand the seller’s situation

Analyze motivation, condition, timeline, and price expectations

Negotiate purchase prices with sellers

Lock up properties under contract for wholesale deals

Keep clean notes and follow-up tasks inside the CRM

Work with our team to move deals from lead to signed contract



Required Experience:



You must have previous experience locking up wholesaling deals with sellers

You must understand the real estate wholesaling process

You must be comfortable negotiating directly with homeowners

You must know how to handle objections around price, repairs, timing, and competing offers

You must be reliable, organized, and available during U.S. business hours



Who This Is Best For:



This role is best for someone who has already worked as an acquisitions rep, closer, or sales rep for a wholesaling company and wants a serious opportunity with consistent seller leads.



We are not looking for someone who only has general VA experience. We are looking for someone who knows how to close motivated sellers and get contracts signed.



Compensation:



Base pay plus performance bonuses/commission based on closed deals.



Strong closers will have the opportunity to earn more as results increase.



To Apply, Please Send:



Your previous real estate wholesaling acquisitions experience

How many wholesale deals you have helped lock up

A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your experience

Your availability during U.S. business hours

title: Content Strategist/Social Media Manager
description:
We are hiring a full-time Content Strategist + Social Media Manager to help drive growth and revenue across Instagram,
, Linkedin and TikTok.



This is not an entry-level social media role, and it is not a “just keep the content calendar full” position.



We are looking for someone who has already helped brands grow and monetize through short vertical video, can clearly explain how they did it, and can step into an established personal brand with both strategy and execution skills.



About the Brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, 
 and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income.



Our business includes:



low-ticket offers and live challenges

webinars and launch campaigns

a membership

a flagship course and higher-ticket offers



We are a systems-driven team with clear processes, deadlines, and communication standards. We move fast, especially during launch periods, and we are looking for someone who can keep up, think strategically, and execute without needing constant direction.



What This Role Actually Is



This role sits at the intersection of content strategy, conversion strategy, and day-to-day social media execution.



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to post content.

We are looking for someone who understands how to use content to:



grow the right audience

build trust and authority

support active offers

convert attention into leads and sales

create a repeatable content system the team can execute consistently



You should be able to think like a strategist and work like an operator.



What We Are Looking For



You are likely a fit if the following describes you:



1) You have a real content strategy framework



You do not “wing it” or rely on random content ideas.



You have a repeatable process for:



auditing a brand, its audience, and its offers

identifying what content should drive reach vs trust vs conversion

building content pillars and campaign-specific content plans

turning strategy into hooks, scripts, captions, CTAs, and content direction

reviewing performance and adjusting based on what the data says



We are not looking for vague “I help brands show up consistently” language.

We want someone who can clearly explain how you build a content strategy that drives business results.



2) You have proof that your work has driven both growth and revenue



We are looking for someone who has helped brands grow accounts and support monetization.



That means you should be able to show:



accounts you have worked on

what the numbers looked like before you got involved

what changed after your strategy was implemented

how your content supported lead generation, launches, offer sales, or conversions



Views and followers are not enough on their own. We care about business impact.



3) You understand short vertical video deeply



You should have strong working knowledge of:



TikTok

 LinkedIn

Instagram Reels

 content strategy



You should understand that content cannot simply be reposted everywhere without thought. We want someone who knows how to think strategically about each platform while still creating a cohesive overall brand content system.



4) You can execute what you strategize



This is not a strategy-only role.



You should be comfortable actually doing the work required to move the strategy forward, including:



developing weekly content direction

writing hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs

organizing and managing content calendars

scheduling and publishing content

adjusting content during launches and promotions

collaborating with the founder and internal team on what gets created next



5) You are highly organized and proactive



We move quickly. You should be someone who:



meets deadlines without being chased

communicates proactively

can work inside structured systems

can keep multiple moving pieces organized during launch periods

is comfortable collaborating with a founder who is also a strategist

What This Role Involves



Your responsibilities will include:



Deep diving into the Keenya Kelly brand, including audience, offers, voice, content pillars, and competitors

Developing a content strategy based on where the brand is going, not just what has been posted before

Delivering weekly content direction for Instagram, LinkedIn,
, and TikTok

Creating hooks, script direction, captions, and CTAs tied to active offers

Delivering one Trial Reels concept per day for Instagram

Managing day-to-day content execution on the accounts you are directing

Scheduling and publishing content

Building and maintaining a content system the team can use, including:

competitor tracking

content ideas and hook libraries

campaign content planning

content direction frameworks

Joining bi-weekly strategy calls to review performance and align on the next content cycle

Adapting quickly during active launches, live challenges, webinars, and campaign periods

You Are the Right Fit If…

You have a documented, repeatable process for content strategy

You can show at least 2 examples of accounts you helped grow and monetize

You understand the difference between content for audience growth, authority/trust, and sales

You know how to support a business with multiple offers and live launches

You are comfortable switching between strategy and execution

You can collaborate well with a founder who already understands content strategy

You communicate clearly and do not disappear when things get busy

You are comfortable with deadlines, structure, and accountability

This Is Not the Right Role If…



Please do not apply if any of the following are true:



You are still learning social media strategy and building your process as you go

Your experience is mostly engagement, posting support, or content coordination without measurable strategy results

You cannot clearly explain how your content strategy has supported sales or conversions

You cannot provide proof of accounts you have grown

You only want to strategize and do not want to touch execution

You need to fully own every creative decision in order to do your best work

title: Virtual Assistant with a Creative Storytelling Side (Long-Term, Full-Time)
description:
I run a growing content agency and I'm looking for a reliable, hard-working VA with excellent English and a creative mind, someone who wants a long-term home and is ready to grow with us as we scale.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. Your day-to-day will vary: researching trending content on US social media, organizing findings into docs and sheets, writing short captions and simple scripts, managing tasks on our project board, and supporting the team with whatever the week needs. Some days are research-heavy, some are writing-heavy. I'll teach you our systems and exactly how we work.

The creative side matters too: the best fit is someone who enjoys storytelling, notices why content goes viral, and can write short, natural, human-sounding captions and scripts when needed. You don't need to be a professional writer, but you need the instinct.

You're a fit if you:



Are a consistent, high-output worker who takes pride in delivering every single day

Write and speak excellent, natural English

Are organized, self-driven, and don't need hand-holding

Enjoy social media and understand US content culture

Have a creative, storytelling side (captions, scripts, ideas)

Want a long-term role and real growth, not a short gig



What the trial looks like (please read this carefully): We start with a 1-week paid trial with clear daily deliverables and a short daily check-in. I'm very transparent about expectations: this role is about consistent daily output, and the trial reflects the real job. If you deliver, this becomes a stable long-term position with room to grow.

Details: Full-time (8–10 hrs/day). $500–650/month depending on experience, paid every two weeks via Wise, with raises based on performance.

To apply: Start your message with the word "CONSISTENT". Then tell me two things in a few sentences: (1) one piece of US content trending right now (link it) and why you think it works, and (2) the highest-output week you've ever had in a job — what did you actually produce?

Generic applications will be ignored.

title: Custom Experience Manager | Ecommerce - Shopify
description:
We're a growing e-commerce brand looking for a Customer Experience Manager to own and elevate the entire customer journey. This is a strategic role, not a support desk job. You won't be processing refunds or answering tickets; you'll be analyzing how customers experience our brand and making it measurably better.



What you'll do:

– Map the full customer journey — from first ad click to post-purchase and re-order — and identify where we can improve

– Analyze customer data, support trends, reviews, and feedback to surface pain points and opportunities

– Turn insights into recommendations: better policies, clearer communication, smoother flows, stronger retention

– Own key CX metrics (CSAT, NPS, retention, repeat rate) and report on what's moving them

– Work cross-functionally with marketing, product, and operations to roll out experience improvements

– Shape our post-purchase experience — onboarding, education, subscription lifecycle, and loyalty

– Set the standards and playbooks our support team follows, without owning the day-to-day queue



You're a great fit if you:

– Have experience improving customer experience or retention for an e-commerce/DTC brand

– Think analytically — comfortable pulling insights from data, reviews, and customer feedback

– Can translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations and see them through

– Understand the Shopify ecosystem and post-purchase/subscription journeys

– Communicate and influence well across teams

– Bonus: experience with subscriptions (Loop, Recharge), supplements/health products, or a high-growth brand



To apply, tell us about a customer experience you analyzed and improved — what you found, what you changed, and the impact.

title: Full time video editor for marketing agency
description:
About Chi Media

Chi Media is a full-service marketing agency running social-first content, campaigns, and paid media for a growing portfolio of hospitality, retail, and lifestyle clients. Video is at the center of almost everything we produce, Reels, TikToks, BTS content, ads, and client campaigns and we're looking for a dedicated Video Editor to own that output as our team and client roster grow.

T

he Role

We're hiring a remote Video Editor to take raw footage across a wide range of clients and turn it into polished, on-brand, platform-ready content fast, consistently, and at volume. This is not a purely execution-only role: we want someone with a strong creative eye who can also help shape what we shoot in the first place, not just cut what's handed to them.

Sometimes the videos are in Dutch. You don't need to speak Dutch, but you do need a clear, reliable process for editing it accurately



What You'll Do

• Edit raw footage into polished short-form and long-form content, both mobile and professional for: Reels, TikToks, BTS, and paid ad creative, across multiple client accounts simultaneously

• Edit footage and audio in both English and Dutch, including dialogue, voiceovers, and interviews, using transcripts, translated shotlists, subtitle files, or AI transcription/translation tools to cut and caption accurately without relying on fluency

• Add on-brand captions and burned-in subtitles (Dutch and English), motion graphics, sound design, and pacing suited to each platform

• Pitch shoot concepts, storyboards, and content ideas ahead of shoots, trend-aware angles, formats, and hooks tailored to each client's goals

• Collaborate with account leads on shotlists before shoots so edits are planned in advance, not improvised after the fact

• Manage a high volume of deliverables across 10+ client accounts with overlapping deadlines

• Follow Chi Media's file naming, versioning, and upload conventions so all raw and edited content stays organized and accessible

• Stay current on platform-specific trends and formats across Instagram, TikTok,



What You'll Bring

• Minimum 3+ years experience

• A strong portfolio or demo reel is required we want to see range: mobile, professional content, paid ad creative, interviews, and fast-turnaround social edits

• A track record of pitching creative ideas, not just executing them shoot

concepts, formats, hooks, trends adapted to a brand

• A clear, proven process for editing non-English (ideally including Dutch or another European language) audio content, per above

• Proficiency in Premiere Pro, CapCut, and/or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong instincts for pacing, sound design, and trend-aware short-form editing

• Comfortable managing a high volume of deliverables across many clients and deadlines at once

• Reliable, fast turnaround and strong written communication in English

• A stable remote setup high-speed internet, hardware capable of smooth 4K editing, and your own software licenses



Nice to Have

• Prior experience editing content for hospitality, retail, ecom or lifestyle brands

• Experience with AI-assisted transcription/translation workflows for editing non-nativelanguage footage

• Motion graphics or animation skills

• Basic Dutch reading comprehension (not required, but a plus)

title: Workflow Coordinator for US Install Company
description:
Full-Time | 40–50 Hours Per Week | Weekly Pay



 **Do you love organizing chaos?**



Are you the person everyone relies on because you never let things get forgotten?



Do you naturally follow up with people until things are finished?



Do you enjoy bringing order to busy, fast-moving environments?



If you're reading those questions and thinking...



**"That's me."**



...keep reading.



We believe this could become one of the most important positions in our company.



---



This Is NOT a Typical Virtual Assistant Position



We're looking for someone to become our **Workflow Coordinator**.



Your job isn't to install security cameras.



Your job isn't to manage projects.



Your job isn't to tell people what to do.



**Your job is to keep our company moving.**



Every day, you'll help make sure commitments are completed, projects continue moving forward, and nothing falls through the cracks.



You'll become the person who always knows:



* What's behind.

* What's blocked.

* What still needs to be done.

* Who needs help.

* What leadership should know.



You become the eyes and ears of our operation.



---

What You'll Actually Do



You'll work closely with our leadership team, project managers, technicians, schedulers, and office staff.



Some of your daily responsibilities will include:



* Following up with technicians before, during, and after installations.

* Making sure required paperwork and photos have been uploaded.

* Checking that equipment has been brought online.

* Monitoring project portals for work that hasn't been scheduled.

* Attending our weekly operations meetings.

* Taking detailed meeting notes.

* Tracking action items assigned during meetings.

* Following up until those action items are completed.

* Helping identify problems before they become emergencies.

* Keeping leadership informed about what's happening across the company.



You won't assume something has been completed.



You'll verify it.



---



We Don't Just Want Updates...



We Want Someone Who Thinks.



If you notice:



* technicians forgetting the same paperwork...

* projects repeatedly falling behind...

* communication breaking down...

* recurring mistakes...

* delays that keep happening...



...we don't just want you to tell us.



We want you to help us understand **why** it's happening.



You'll work directly with leadership to improve our systems, solve recurring problems, and make the company better every week.



Your ideas matter here.



---



 We Will Train You Personally



You do **NOT** need experience with security cameras.



You do **NOT** need construction experience.



We'll personally train you from the ground up.



We're hiring for organization, ownership, curiosity, and follow-through.



We'll teach you everything else.



---



The Person We're Looking For



You may be perfect for this role if you:



* Love organization.

* Naturally make lists and checklists.

* Notice details other people miss.

* Enjoy following up with people.

* Stay calm when there are lots of moving pieces.

* Like helping teams stay organized.

* Are comfortable asking questions.

* Don't stop after asking once—you follow through until the task is completed.

* Take pride in helping other people succeed.



If people describe you as "the organized one," we'd love to meet you.



---



Schedule



* **40–50 hours per week**

* Must be available during **U.S. Pacific Time business hours** We can find the hours that work for us both!

* 9AM PST to 7PM PST is ideal but we can figure it out for the correct person for the role. We may be able to find something closer to CST hours as well.

* Weekly pay

* Long-term position with opportunities for growth





---



Before You Apply



We'd like you to answer one question.



There isn't a perfect answer.



We're interested in **how you think.**



Scenario



Imagine it's Monday morning.



You begin your workday and discover the following:



* 18 technicians are working in the field today.

* 5 projects haven't been scheduled.

* 3 technicians forgot to upload required paperwork yesterday.

* Two installations are behind schedule.

* Last week's meeting created 12 action items for different tea
mbers.

* Three of those action items are now overdue.

* One customer is waiting for an update.

* One technician is waiting on equipment.

* Several tea
mbers have already messaged you asking for help.



You cannot solve every problem yourself.



Your job is to help keep the company moving.



Tell us:



* What would you do first?

* How would you organize your day?

* How would you d
 what needs attention first?

* How would you make sure nothing gets forgotten?

* What system would you use to track everything?

* How would you communicate with the team?

* If you noticed the same problem happening over and over again, what would you do?



There isn't a right answer.



We're looking for someone who naturally thinks in systems, organization, follow-through, communication, and continuous improvement.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
